research_notes: Both CVBs are closely affiliated and share email infrastructure. Ashtabula County CVB has comprehensive staff information available. Geneva-on-the-Lake CVB uses shared contact system with county CVB.

target_buyers.fit_rationale: Official county tourism site promoting 30+ wineries, 19 covered bridges, state parks, and fishing. A trip planner/itinerary builder would enhance visitor engagement and length of stay.
